integrity: The classification is proved from original defensive inequalities; checked by independent finite enumeration. No independent external scientific audit or certification is claimed.
scientific_limitations: Finite simple clique bouquets with t>=2 and each peripheral clique of order >=2; the ordinary defensive-alliance notion with global inclusion-minimality. Finite checks are not a proof of the infinite theorem; equivalent unindexed literature may exist.
title: Parity dichotomy for globally minimal defensive alliances in clique bouquets
